Maria CSM: Heads up — BrightlineHealth just started sending a bunch more traffic under org 'brightline-prod'. Saw a 6x TPS increase over last 24h. New projects from their mobile team + clinical analytics.
Sam SE: Nice, can you paste 24h usage? any change in model choice or token lengths?
Maria CSM: Topline — tokens/day 12M -> 72M. Mostly short chat messages (avg 120 tokens) but spike in concurrency. No model change, still using redwood-standard-2.
Akshay PS: Sounds like candidate for Dedicated or autoscale bump. There's a cost risk on hosted if this persists.
Jana Support: Are they onboarding new teams via SSO? Any new service accounts?
Maria CSM: Yep — two new service accounts: mobile-inbound, analytics-batch. Email from client: "we're ramping mobile chat and analytics ingest next week"
Sam SE: Can we get telemetry? query:
```
GET /v1/usage?org=brightline-prod&from=1761910000&to=1762000000
```
Maria CSM: Pasted snippet:
```
mobile-inbound: 48M tokens
analytics-batch: 18M tokens
web-ui: 6M tokens
```
Akshay PS: Recommend outreach: 1) quick architecture review for mobile team 2) offer 30-day Dedicated trial + migration plan 3) enable prefix caching on analytics ingestion
Maria CSM: I'll propose a call. Also capture ask for predictable latency SLA — they're worried about 503s during peak.
Sam SE: For Dedicated trial, need quota approval from infra and pricing ok from sales.
Akshay PS: I'll open internal ticket.
Akshay PS: Ticket: INF-8245 — evaluate Dedicated trial for Brightline, include perf run and cost model.
OnboardBot: New meeting scheduled by Maria CSM: 2025-09-12 16:00 UTC — "Brightline: expansion + perf review" :calendar:
Maria CSM: Also capturing feedback: they said model output hallucinations on clinical codes were higher. Want help with prompt template + evals.
Jana Support: I'll run an eval sweep and attach results to the ticket.
Maria CSM: Risk note: renewal in 3 months — if cost spikes and SLA not met they may push back. Need exec sponsor touchpoint.
Sam SE: I'll draft a short exec summary for account lead.
Maria CSM: Thanks. Will follow up after the meeting. :thumbsup:
